{{Top|leg}}
'''Frequency J-33-567-Y32''' was a communications channel used by [[Starship/Legends|starships]] arriving at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Merisee/Legends|Merisee]]. The frequency was to be used by ships that had previously scheduled their arrivals.
